preconditions.expression: isinstance(arr, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in arr)
preconditions.description: arr is a list of integers.
n is an integer equal to the length of arr.
The array size n is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**4 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in arr is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers with length n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the return value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == -1) or (return_value[i] in arr[i+1:]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each index i, if the result is not -1, the value must appear somewhere to the right of i in the original array.

postconditions.expression: all(((return_value[i] == -1) and all((arr[j] not in arr[i+1:]) or (arr.count(arr[j]) <= arr.count(arr[i])) for j in range(i+1, n))) or ((return_value[i] != -1) and (return_value[i] == arr[next(j for j in range(i+1, n) if arr.count(arr[j]) > arr.count(arr[i]))])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each index i, if no element to the right has a strictly greater frequency, the result is -1; otherwise, the result is the value of the first (closest) element to the right whose frequency is strictly greater than the frequency of arr[i].
